Summary: Mid-market SaaS (B2B product search) evaluating Redwood hosted API for quick onboarding and then Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation.

Recent timeline:
- 2025-10-15: Intro demo (hosted API embeddings + semantic search). Hosted demo used product catalog ~120k rows; initial embedding pipeline via batch call (5000 vectors job) — team liked quality; noted cost sensitivity.
- 2025-10-22: Technical deep-dive with Priya (SE) on vector DB choices; they are leaning toward Pinecone but open to Redwood's recommended pairings. Discussed nearline batch pipeline and streaming updates.
- 2025-11-04: Security kickoff (SAML SSO, KMS discussion). Sent security questionnaire (see Drive). Fireflies ff_2025-11-04 recording attached.
- 2025-11-10: Pricing call; finance requested ARR band estimate and per-vector cost options for Hosted vs Dedicated.

Use-case details / Requirements:
- Primary workloads: embeddings for semantic product search (primary), nightly batch embedding jobs (200–500k vectors/day), real-time vector lookups for product recommendations (50–200 qps peak).
- Throughput targets: sustained 100 qps for vector similarity queries, peak 200 qps; batch window <= 2 hours for 500k vectors.
- Latency targets: real-time lookup P95 < 100ms end-to-end (API + vector DB lookup). For embeddings: average embed call < 20ms per vector when batched.
- Model preferences: open to open models (Llama2-style) and Redwood-curated embeddings; they want a fallback plan if Hosted capacity constrained.
- Integration: backend is Postgres + Redis; currently using Pinecone for vectors in dev. Interested in testing Redwood + Pinecone vs Redwood-managed vector layer suggestions.
- Security/compliance: SAML SSO, audit logs retention 12 months, KMS integration (AWS KMS), EU data residency for EU customers.

POC plan discussed:
- Phase 1 (hosted): 2-week sandbox to validate embed quality and end-to-end search relevance. Run sample ranking tests vs baseline (current Pinecone + OpenAI embeddings).
- Phase 2 (dedicated perf): 4-week Dedicated POC to validate throughput (100–200 qps), autoscaling behavior, cost per million embeddings, and KV cache behaviors. Run nightly batch job of 500k vectors.
- Metrics: relevance (MRR/NDCG on labeled set), per-vector cost, avg token cost (for any generation), end-to-end latency p50/p95.

- CTO (Miguel Ortega): "We need predictable unit economics; if we go Dedicated we need clear per-vector and per-qps costing."
- Head of Product (Laura Kim): "Search must be sub-100ms for recommendations — users notice lag."

- Best practice for pairing with Pinecone vs a Redwood-managed vector cache (cost/latency tradeoffs).
